D2 AC-MUT 'reds exactly its named killer' is unachievable (M1, M15 red T3/T4/T7 too). Resolved: named killer in red set; full set recorded.
D3 a reset that lands before the hello write: Linux reports it on the write and the read then returns EOF (by reading, not measured). Resolved: clean EOF requires a successful hello write.
D4 a partial nonce prefix ending at the deadline is 'foreign' under §4.2 vs §4.3's 'child or silent' claim. Not adopted; flagged.
D5 picker/nonce failure on attempt 2/3 unspecified. Resolved: refuse 'reverse leg: no free port'.
D6 exhaustion count = attempts made (M2 text 'inconclusive after 1').
D7 cosmetic: AC-CI cites ci.yml:254-257; guard loop is :254-256.
